title: Philippians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Philippians 1: thanksgiving for the saints at Philippi, bonds that spread the Good News, and living and dying for Christ.

questions.text: Who are named as writing to the saints at Philippi?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 names Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, writing to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants.

answers.text: Paul and Silvanus
Paul and Epaphroditus
Paul and Luke
Paul and Timothy

questions.text: Of what is the writer confident concerning them?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he is confident that he who began a good work in them will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

answers.text: That they will be spared all affliction until the day of Christ
That he who began a good work in them will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ
That he will see them again in Philippi before the winter
That their whole city will receive the Good News of Christ

questions.text: What does he pray their love may do?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says he prays that their love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment.

answers.text: Cover over every complaint among them
Reach the assemblies throughout Macedonia and Achaia
Abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment
Return to what it was on the very first day

questions.text: To whom did it become evident that his bonds are in Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that his bonds are in Christ.

answers.text: The whole palace guard, and all the rest
The rulers of the synagogue
The overseers and servants at Philippi
The sailors who carried him

questions.text: Out of what does verse 15 say some preach Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says some preach Christ out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

answers.text: Out of fear, and some out of hope
Out of envy and strife, and some out of good will
Out of custom, and some out of duty
Out of poverty, and some out of need

questions.text: What does he say he rejoices in, whether Christ is preached in pretense or in truth?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and he rejoices in this and will rejoice.

answers.text: That his chains are loosed
That his accusers are silenced
That Christ is proclaimed
That the brothers are at peace

questions.text: How does verse 21 complete the words "For to me to live is Christ, and to die is..."?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 reads "For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain."

answers.text: Gain
Rest
Glory
Loss

questions.text: He is hard pressed between departing to be with Christ and remaining in the flesh. What does he say about remaining?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says that to remain in the flesh is more needful for their sake.

answers.text: It is a burden he would gladly lay down
It is the choice he has already made
It is hidden from him until the day of Christ
It is more needful for their sake

questions.text: How does he want to hear that they stand?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says he wants to hear that they stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News.

answers.text: Firm in the traditions he handed to them when he came
Firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News
Quietly, each one minding his own house and his own work
Ready to leave the city if trouble comes upon them

questions.text: What does verse 29 say has been granted to them on behalf of Christ?
questions.explanation: Verse 29 says it has been granted to them on behalf of Christ not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf.

answers.text: To judge those who now oppose them at Philippi
To be kept from every adversary who stands against them
Not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf
To speak with boldness before kings and governors
